theme: An open Saturday, a fuller Sunday ahead
greeting: A wide-open Saturday in St. Pete, Dan — nothing on the calendar today, which makes it the day to clear a couple of bookings that have been sliding. Tomorrow fills in: the 9 AM Sunday review with Mike, then the island annual meeting at 5.

needsAttention.title: Settle your proxy for tomorrow's island meeting
needsAttention.detail: Mark Hoffman asked whether you're attending the DIRA & DIBA annual meeting tomorrow at 5 PM, or to send him or David your proxy so the vote has a quorum. You've already accepted on the calendar, so a one-line reply closes it.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas rental
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority task in Dan & Mike Stuff, overdue since Sept 14. A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market and sells out — holding a refundable booking now costs nothing and takes the risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The p2 call in Dan & Mike Stuff was meant to be decided by Sept 30 and booked by Oct 15, both now past. All four girls, Dec 13–Jan 2, across the thinnest holiday inventory of the year — pick domestic vs. international and get a shortlist moving.

flagged.title: ICGN board dinner invitation, Toronto
flagged.detail: ICGN invited you to its board dinner on Nov 3, the evening before the conference — worth an RSVP given the governance circle in the room.

flagged.title: Valoris note from Mike Lubrano
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano at Valoris sent a message titled "Board Products" — a direct note from a governance contact you already work with on the ICGN plenary.

inbox.clear: Nothing else in the primary inbox is waiting on a reply.
